track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 26: Tarz
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Tarz in Homayoun, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on D in Tarz. The line peaks at D4 (295.3 Hz) at 0:46.1. It closes on the tonic (Bk3 → D4 → D4 → Db4 → A3 → A3).
